messages:
Sam: quick heads-up from QA: rerank preview table is announcing the score twice with NVDA when you open the inspector. reproduces on Win10 + Chrome. Jules: thanks — is it only the score? any other duplicate reads? Sam: score + "source" field are repeated. NVDA reads the visible number, then a screen-reader-only label. suspect we added SR labels for context but didn't aria-hidden the visual nodes. Riley: hmm we added SR copy to clarify score meaning for non-experts (eg 'Higher means more relevant') — maybe keep the explanation but ensure only the SR copy is read, visual is aria-hidden. Hannah: product tradeoff: we want the explanatory text discoverable to screen reader users but not noisy. suggestion: use an aria-describedby id on the row and keep a single SR label for the number. Diego: accessibility nit: when bulk-selecting rows (shift+click) there is no live announcement. keyboard users don't get feedback for large batches. can we add a polite aria-live region that says "X items selected"? Eve: +1 to aria-live. Implementation sketch: 
<div aria-live=\"polite\" aria-atomic=\"true\" class=\"sr-only\" id=\"selection-announcer\"></div>
// update text when selection changes: document.getElementById('selection-announcer').textContent = `${count} items selected`;
Jules: good. also we need to rethink virtualization + focus. When the list is virtualized and inspector opens, focus jumps but the focused row might be unmounted if scrolled. We should ensure the virtual scroller pins the item or move focus into the inspector pane. Riley: copy suggestion for rerank threshold tooltip: "Rerank threshold: only show results with score above this value (0.0 - 1.0). Higher = more aggressive filtering." shorter alt: "Only show results scoring above this threshold." Hannah: export CSV ordering mismatch again — current CSV header = id,score,metadata,vector but the visible table order is checkbox,id,metadata,score. CSV should match the visual table order excluding controls. please standardize and document in the export modal. Diego: performance note: adding aria-live updates for every selection could spam assistive tech. debounce updates to fire after 150-300ms and collapse batch changes to a single announcement. Eve: a11y audit ask: can design provide a small spec for SR copy for the relevance column and one-liner tooltip copy for threshold + compact density, so engineers don't invent wording? Sam: sure, here's minimal spec we can use: - relevance column: SR-only label = "Relevance" + value (e.g., "Relevance: 0.92"). Visual number must be aria-hidden. - tooltip for threshold: "Filter results by minimum relevance score. Values closer to 1.0 yield fewer, but more relevant, matches." - compact toggle copy: "Dense rows (opt-in) — display more items per page; may affect keyboard navigation in very large lists." Jules: design follow-up: I'll add those strings into the Figma components and map them to the tooltip microcopy tokens. Riley can you check the grid/role semantics? using role=\"grid\" with aria-rowcount might help NVDA announce position. Riley: yes, role=\"grid\" + aria-rowindex + aria-rowcount is good for table-like keyboard navigation. but watch out: role grid changes default keyboard mechanics; ensure we preserve arrow key expectations. Hannah: small visual accessibility nit: contrast of the score pill on dark theme is borderline at 3.8:1. need to bump to 4.5:1 or find a different treatment (outline + text) for compliance. Diego: I'll run contrast checks and propose a darker tone for the pill background. Eve: timeline: can we get a small PR for SR fixes + CSV header fix this sprint and schedule a follow-up for virtualization/focus next? Sam: sounds good. I'll open a ticket for aria fixes and the aria-live announcer. tagging @Riley for the grid changes and @Diego for CSV export mapping. thanks all. Jules: :thumbsup: I'll update Figma and add a short a11y checklist to the component page. Riley: will add a unit test to assert export header ordering and a keyboard-nav playtest. Hannah: can we run a quick screen-reader smoke test on staging after the PR? I'll coordinate with QA. Sam: yep I'll coordinate and post results here. thanks everyone!
